meta.title: Prepare the purchase users with different team access

plan.title: Prepare purchase users with team access

steps.note: Enable the required PR team filtering behavior before configuring teams and users.

args.goal: As the admin on the Buyer portal, open Teams and create or edit the teams, set their team types and category or subcategory limitations, apply the Gurgaon location limitation only to User E's team, add Users A through I to the specified teams, and stop on the Teams screen showing all nine users with their configured team access.

steps.note: No dedicated catalog step exists for Teams administration, so perform the complete setup in the buyer portal and require the resulting access assignments to be visible.
Confirm the completed Teams workflow did not leave an application error.
